eras.title: Early championship
eras.note: A small points-paying field and shared drives make consistency and fractional scores important.

eras.title: A second championship
eras.note: Constructor honours appear; driver and constructor eligibility must be read separately.

eras.title: Nine points for a driver win
eras.note: A win becomes more valuable, while only a selection of results counts.

eras.title: Split-season counting
eras.note: Several years limit the counting results in each part of the calendar; a late surge cannot always replace an early dropped score.

eras.title: Best-results championships
eras.note: Some finishes add to points scored without increasing the championship total.

eras.title: Every result counts
eras.note: Ten points reward a win and every eligible score contributes to the championship.

eras.title: Eight scoring places
eras.note: More finishers score and second place moves closer to a win in points value.

eras.title: Twenty-five for a win
eras.note: Ten scoring places and larger totals make raw points across eras difficult to compare.

eras.title: Fastest-lap bonus returns
eras.note: An eligible fastest lap can add a point beyond the finishing-position award.

eras.title: Sprint scoring begins
eras.note: Some weekends now contribute points from two sessions.

eras.title: Expanded Sprint points
eras.note: Eight Sprint finishers score; shortened Grands Prix have distance-based scales.

eras.title: No fastest-lap bonus
eras.note: Grand Prix finishing points stay familiar; the fastest-lap point is removed.
